name: Glycolysis
definition:
Glycolysis is defined as the initial anaerobic enzymatic sequence occurring in the cytosol that
converts one glucose molecule into two molecules of pyruvate.
source_quote:

name: The Mitochondrial Matrix
source_quote:
The mitochondrial matrix is the internal fluid compartment containing metabolic enzymes for the
tricarboxylic acid cycle.

name: Atp Synthase
source_quote:
ATP synthase is the transmembrane enzyme complex that harnesses the proton electrochemical
gradient across the inner mitochondrial membrane to synthesize adenosine triphosphate.

name: The Nucleus
definition:
The nucleus refers to the membrane-enclosed organelle that houses the genetic material in the form
of linear DNA and coordinates cell activities such as growth, metabolism, and protein synthesis.
source_quote:

name: Cellular Respiration
definition:
Cellular respiration refers to the metabolic pathway that breaks down glucose molecules to produce
ATP in the presence of oxygen.

name: Ribosomes
definition:
Rough endoplasmic reticulum is studded with ribosomes and specializes in protein synthesis and
folding for secretable proteins.

name: Lysosomes
definition:
The Golgi apparatus refers to the eukaryotic organelle composed of polar cisternae that modifies,
sorts, and packages glycoproteins and lipids for secretion or delivery to lysosomes.

name: Autophagy
definition:
Autophagy is the catabolic cellular process whereby damaged organelles are degraded within
autophagosomes fused to lysosomes.

name: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum
definition:
Smooth endoplasmic reticulum refers to the tubular agranular membrane network dedicated to lipid
synthesis, carbohydrate metabolism, and calcium ion sequestration.
